sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Merchant Acquiring and Clearing Service Provider (PSP)

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law heritage with French Civil Law influences, codified by the Vanuatu Constitution and post-independence statutes, with significant local jurisprudence from the Anglo-French Condominium era)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus Regional Trade Agreement (2020),Vanuatu — New Zealand
Vanuatu — Fiji Trade Agreement in Goods & Services (2008)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Companies Registry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for Apostille Convention member states; otherwise Consular Legalization through the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs and relevant foreign embassy

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registered Agent in Vanuatu / Notary Public (attested copy)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for member states; Consular Legalization for non-member states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization (depending on destination state)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing for Founding Shareholders and Directors

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based CDD/EDD screening of all proposed directors, shareholders, control persons, ultimate beneficial owners, and transaction counterparties against the Vanuatu VFSC PEP List, the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, the UK HMT Sanctions List, the Australian DFAT Consolidated List, OFAC SDN Non-SDN Lists, and the Vanuatu Domestic Proscribed Persons List. Enhanced due diligence must be applied for any PEP, PEP family member, or close associate using a verified third-party integrity database. Source-of-funds and source-of-wealth documentation is mandatory for any beneficial owner holding 25% or more, and for any individual involved in a High-Risk_Special_License payment gateway application.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Company Name Search & Reservation System via the official VFSC eRegistry portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All company names must be expressed in the Latin alphabet. Official corporate names may be in English, French, or Bislama only, but the distinctive part of the name must be transliterated into Roman script if the underlying corporate name originated from a non-Latin alphabet. A legal suffix is mandatory using one of the prescribed forms: 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Société Anonyme', 'SA', 'Corporation', 'Inc', or another as approved by VFSC.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a name rejection notice issued by VFSC's Companies Registry, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice date. The appeal is addressed to the VFSC Registrar of Companies and must state grounds of factual or legal error, include a proposed amended name, and be accompanied by any supporting evidence of non-confusion or non-offensiveness. The Registry shall issue a reasoned decision within 21 business days. If the appeal is denied, the applicant may proceed to the Vanuatu Supreme Court for judicial review. A fresh name reservation may be filed after the appeal exhaustion without prejudice.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office arrangements are not acceptable as the sole principal place of business for a licensed payment service provider in Vanuatu. A licensed IC that engages in cross-border payment gateway activities rangschemes will require a physical registered office in Port Vila, Efate, ordinarily at the office of a licensed registered agent, which must employ at least one natural person resident in Vanuatu to receive official communications and service of process. The VFSC may allow a leased desk or suite within a licensed registered agent's physical premises for a nominal fee, but a pure 'virtual mailbox' will be treated as non-compliant.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High. For a High-Risk_Special_License PSP applicant, the VFSC performs an initial pre-licensing physical inspection in roughly 85% of high-risk payment gateway applications, and thereafter unannounced periodic inspections at intervals averaging every 12–18 months during the first three years of operation. The risk of unannounced physical inspection is quantified at 75% within the first 24 months.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Escrowed pre-incorporation legal and compliance opinion (VFSC business licence pre-screen)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vanuatu legal counsel / licensed law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a pre-incorporation legal opinion for a licensed payment service provider

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (as amended), ss 3, 7-12 (incorporation), s 35 (registered office), ss 44-46 (directors and secretary); Companies Management Act [Cap 222A] (licensed registered agents)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies and International Trusts Division, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation (Form 3) and Memorandum and Articles of Association lodged under s 8 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; resulting Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed; shares of no par value are permitted. No escrow account is required for an International Company. A Vanuatu-registered office and a VFSC-licensed registered agent are mandatory statutory appointments.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Memorandum and Articles of Association as filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission be adopted. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the allotment of one hundred ordinary shares at no par value to the founding subscriber be approved and recorded in the register of members. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office be established at the licensed registered agent's office in Port Vila, Vanuatu. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the subscriber present be appointed sole Director and Corporate Secretary. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the Director is authorized to execute contracts, open bank accounts, file the payment gateway license application with the VFSC, and pay all fees to commence business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies and International Trusts Division (lodged via licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two to three proposed company names through a VFSC-licensed registered agent. Names must end with 'Limited', 'Corporation', or 'Incorporated'. Await written name clearance prior to lodging incorporation documents.
required_dossiers: Engagement letter of licensed registered agent
Notarized passport copy of founding subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Resubmit alternative names; appeal the refusal in writing to the VFSC Registrar within 14 days of the notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and execution of constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent and notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association, registered agent consent, and director consent. Have all execution pages notarized and file original counterpart copies with the registered agent for onward submission.
required_dossiers: Form 1 - Consent to Act as Registered Agent
Notarized proof of identity and address of subscriber and director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct defective signatures or notarizations and re-execute the instruments; a nominal resubmission fee may apply.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgment of application and issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies and International Trusts Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the Application for Incorporation (Form 3) with the constitutional documents and pay the statutory fee. The VFSC verifies compliance and issues the Certificate of Incorporation and registered agent certificate.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond in writing to VFSC requisitions within 21 days, amending the lodged documents; re-lodge with an explanation letter if the application lapses.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation corporate governance and bank account setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting, adopt the first board resolution, issue share certificates, open the statutory registers, and obtain the certificate of good standing for banking purposes.
required_dossiers: Share certificates and register of members
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify any registry discrepancies at the registered agent's office and file a correction notice with VFSC if the register error appears on the public record.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment service provider licensing and AML/CFT registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Licensing Division and Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the financial dealer's license application under the Financial Dealers (Agents Licensing) Act [Cap 226] accompanied by the AML/CFT compliance program and beneficial ownership particulars, and register as a reporting institution under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2024.
required_dossiers: Detailed business plan and payment gateway operating model
AML/CFT policies, procedures, and risk assessment
Fit and proper declarations of directors and shareholders
Corporate bank reference and source of funds statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Address VFSC due diligence queries or impose licensing conditions; file representations and additional documentary evidence within 30 days of the deficiency notice.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) in conjunction with the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu for payment systems oversight; sector licensing under the Financial Dealers (Agents Licensing) Act [Cap 226]
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Financial Dealer's Licence (Payment Service Provider / Merchant Acquiring and Clearing category) under the Financial Dealers (Agents Licensing) Act [Cap 226], and Money Service Business registration under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2024

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and National Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 - Exempt / Registration Only (non-industrial digital services); no full EIA Report required for a pure online payment gateway operation, subject to DEPC registration and waste declaration
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial effluent or VOC emissions generated; office sanitary wastewater must comply with municipal sewer consent limits where applicable (BOD not exceeding 50 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 50 mg/L); electronic and electrical equipment waste (e-waste) must be consigned to a DEPC-licensed contractor under the Waste Management Act [Cap 283]

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Clearance and annual inspection by the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Services; building occupancy certificate under the Vanuatu Building Act; workplace health and safety risk assessment and clearance under the Employment Act [Cap 160]; physical security and essential services inspection of payment gateway data infrastructure and server rooms

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Government of Vanuatu; online filing and taxpayer services via the Vanuatu Integrated Taxpayer and Tax System (VITTS) accessible through the official national portal https://www.gov.vu; company incorporation and licensing registry for International Companies: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), https://www.vfsc.vu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Foreign beneficial owners incorporate an International Company (IC) with the VFSC under the International Companies Act [CAP 222] and obtain the Certificate of Incorporation, registered office address, and first director/beneficial owner filings. Step 2: Apply to the DCIR for a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) using the VFSC incorporation certificate, constitutional documents, registered agent address, and declaration of beneficial ownership; submission is made through the VITTS portal or in person at DCIR. Step 3: Because Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, no income-tax registration or annual corporate return applies. Step 4: The IC is statutorily exempt from VAT, stamp duty, and all other national taxes under the International Companies Act; if the IC were to make local taxable supplies exceeding the VAT threshold (prohibited in substance for ICs), mandatory VAT registration would be triggered. A pure international payment-gateway IC remains outside the VAT net and requires no VAT ID.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None applicable. Vanuatu has no corporate income tax, no check-the-box election, and no domestic hybrid-mismatch or entity-classification election regime. The International Companies Act [CAP 222] grants automatic exemption from all Vanuatu taxes and duties, excluding prescribed registration and annual fees. An IC may elect in its constitution to restrict shareholding to non-residents, elect to convert into a domestic limited company, or elect voluntary VAT registration where it intends to make taxable supplies to Vanuatu residents; no Pillar Two, CFC, or transparent-entity elections exist under Vanuatu law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act [CAP 246], administered by the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Compulsory VAT registration for any person whose taxable turnover exceeds VT 5,000,000 in any 12-month rolling period (approximately USD 42,000); voluntary registration permitted below the threshold; ICs engaging exclusively in international business are exempt from VAT registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time electronic invoicing, fiscal clearance, API reporting, digital stamping, or continuous transaction-control regime exists in Vanuatu. Suppliers must issue a VAT tax invoice under section 14 of the VAT Act [CAP 246] showing the supplier's name and address, VAT registration number, invoice date, description of goods/services, taxable amount excluding VAT, and the VAT charged. Export zero-rated invoices must cross-reference the approved Customs Export Declaration; records must be retained for audit by DCIR.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% VAT rate applies to: (a) goods physically exported from Vanuatu under a valid Customs export declaration where the goods leave Vanuatu within the period prescribed by the VAT and Customs law; (b) services supplied to a non-resident who is outside Vanuatu at the time of supply, provided the services are not directly linked to immovable property in Vanuatu and not performed on movable property located in Vanuatu at the time of performance — cross-border merchant acquiring, payment processing, clearing, settlement, and gateway platform services to foreign PSPs and banks qualify where the recipient is outside Vanuatu; (c) internationally supplied services incidental to exported goods, including freight, insurance, and handling. The exporter must prove the non-resident status of the customer, the foreign-currency payment, and the actual cross-border provision of services, and must claim the zero rate on a fully documented VAT return with supporting export evidence.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Executed cross-border services agreement and non-resident customer declaration
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu maintains no statutory exchange-control repatriation deadline, but a 180-day inward-remittance window is the prudent benchmark for export-invoice settlement and VAT refund substantiation. DCIR may audit export zero-rating and refund claims under the VAT Act [CAP 246] and Customs Act [CAP 249]; failure to produce the customs and payment evidence bundle within the statutory periods retroactively makes the supply taxable and exposes the claimant to repayment of the refund with penalty and interest. Fraudulent export claims, false invoices, forged customs declarations, or simulated foreign-payment flows attract penalties of up to 200% of the tax evaded, retrospective clawback of all refunds paid, interest accrual from the date of payment, cancellation of the trader's VAT registration, and criminal prosecution where officers or beneficial owners are shown to have knowingly participated.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) as monetary authority and prudential regulator for banks; foreign exchange administration is liberalized, with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) overseeing the licensing of financial dealers and payment service providers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu (VUV) is fully convertible for both current and capital account transactions for International Companies; no exchange control permission is required for capital injection, profit repatriation, or trade payments. Offshore accounts denominated in USD, AUD, and NZD are widely accepted, and profit remittance is unrestricted, subject to the bank's own evidence requirements (e.g., confirmation of tax exemption status and audited financials).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export proceeds surrender or mandatory conversion requirements exist in Vanuatu. International Companies may retain export receipts in any foreign currency, hold them offshore, or convert freely. The only obligations relate to record-keeping and anti-money laundering transaction reporting.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account plus segregated Client Money Trust Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Low to Medium. Offshore digital EMI entities can be structured under the Vanuatu Financial Dealers Act and regulated by VFSC, but obtaining transactional banking relationships with domestic tier-1 banks is highly constrained due to global de-risking. Most well-known offshore EMIs (e.g., Payoneer, Stripe, PayPal) do not provide direct merchant accounts for Vanuatu-incorporated ICs. Legal constraints include a mandatory local registered agent, substance requirements under the International Companies Act, and enhanced due diligence by correspondent banks that often results in a 'no touch' policy for payment aggregators.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors and beneficial owners must physically appear before a bank officer or a designated correspondent bank representative for initial onboarding and signatory authentication. Remote opening is only permitted in rare cases where the entity has an established operational office in Vanuatu, complete apostilled due-diligence packs, and pre-existing banking references; even then, a personal video interview and notarized board resolution are required.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border online payment aggregation with no local operational footprint
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC Payment Service Provider license; physical office lease with utility receipt; detailed corporate organogram with 100% shareholding disclosure; signed AML/CFT compliance manual; audited financial statements for 2 years; transaction monitoring system certification

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High transaction volume with low average ticket size and rapid movement through accounts
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Merchant settlement agreement; reconciliation notes from principal card networks (Visa/Mastercard); white-label platform documentation; transaction flow diagram; evidence of liquid capital buffer; legal opinion on non-deposit-taking status

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds opacity for initial capital injection from directors/trusts
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank statement or audited source of wealth report for each director; certified copy of trust deed or corporate registry extract for the funding entity; signed statement from a licensed Vanuatu tax agent confirming tax-exempt status; confirmation of no insolvency or adverse sanction screening

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial owner resides in FATF blacklisted or high-risk jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Professional background check by a recognized KYC vendor; police clearance certificate; passport and residence permit of the beneficial owner; economic nexus statement with physical presence in Vanuatu; independent legal opinion on the effectiveness of enhanced due diligence mitigations

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections must be routed via SWIFT MT103/MT202 to a VUV or USD operational account at a licensed local bank. Under Vanuatu's balance-of-payments classification, the intended purpose code for equity injection is '5101' (investment in offshore entity), and for pre-export working capital '5215'. The remitting party must confirm that the funds are not derived from criminal activity; the receiving bank will typically require a board resolution, a formal share issuance letter, and a copy of the VFSC license to verify corporate capacity.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements and merchant payouts are cleared via domestic RTGS for intra-Vanuatu flows and via SWIFT MT103 for cross-border payments. For high-value procurement, commercial letters of credit (MT700) confirmed by an international bank are recommended. USD clearing is executed through the US clearing infrastructure (Fedwire/CHIPS); direct Visa/Mastercard settlement requires a Principal or Principal via a third-party processor with settlement banks in the US or UK, as Vanuatu lacks a local card-clearing system.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla outright forwards (USD/VUV, AUD/VUV) with licensed local banks
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing USD/VUV with offshore bank counterparties, permissible due to absence of exchange controls
Cross-currency swaps (USD/AUD/EUR) with international banking counterparties, subject to bank credit approval

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of an International Company under the International Companies Act (Vanuatu), as amended
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Corporate Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the anniversary of the date of incorporation; return and government fee are payable on or before the anniversary; a maximum 30-calendar-day grace period applies before penalties accrue
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing within 30 days after the anniversary attracts a USD 75 penalty (25% of the annual government fee); each additional month of default accrues a further USD 30 surcharge (10% per month); the Registrar may administratively strike off the International Company after 3 consecutive months of non-payment; restoration requires VFSC consent, full settlement of arrears and penalties, and payment of the statutory restoration fee

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO Confirmation and Shareholding Particulars Record under the Ultimate Beneficial Owner rules introduced by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2021
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Corporate Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted together with the Annual Return on the incorporation anniversary; any share transfer or beneficial ownership movement must be entered in the statutory registers within 14 days of the transfer and confirmed in the next annual UBO filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No separate government fee as the UBO confirmation is bundled with the Annual Return fee; failure to file or a false confirmation constitutes an offence under the 2021 Amendment Act, exposing the company and every defaulting officer to fines and loss of good standing; continued default beyond 3 months may lead to administrative strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal of the VFSC Payment Service Provider / Securities Dealer Licence for cross-border payment gateway and online merchant acquiring operations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Licensing and Supervision
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewal on the licence anniversary date; renewal application must be lodged no later than 30 days before expiry and is approved only where the Annual Return and UBO confirmation are fully up to date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal accrues a USD 150 surcharge (10% of the licence fee) for each month of arrears; the licence lapses automatically if renewal is not completed by the due date; continued cross-border payment processing without a valid licence is unlicensed activity punishable by significant statutory fines, licence revocation, and potential strike-off of the International Company

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual AML/CFT Compliance Return and Risk Assessment Update for the licensed payment gateway business
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - AML/CFT Supervision, with information to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the licensee's financial year-end and in any event before the licence renewal date in the same year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No separate government fee; late or incomplete filing is a regulatory breach of the Proceeds of Crime Act (Vanuatu), as amended, subjecting the licensee to compliance directives, monetary penalties, and possible suspension or revocation of the PSP licence

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: International Companies are exempt from statutory audit and from filing financial statements with VFSC; a mandatory independent certified audit is triggered only when (i) the VFSC PSP licence imposes an audited-accounts condition, (ii) the Commission exercises its discretionary audit power under the International Companies Act where compliance is in question, or (iii) the acquiring bank or Visa/Mastercard scheme rules require audited financial statements of the licensed payment processor
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB; Vanuatu has no separately codified Local GAAP for International Companies; USD is the accepted statutory reporting currency for licensed PSP operations

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must validate and confirm the UBO register with VFSC at every annual return date. Any share transfer causing a change in legal or beneficial ownership must be recorded in the register of members within 14 days, and the updated UBO confirmation must be submitted at the next annual confirmation cycle. Failure to maintain, update, or confirm the register is an offence and may lead to fines and administrative strike-off.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of members' and directors' resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 - 1,500 per annum for the mandatory Vanuatu registered agent and registered office, including corporate secretarial and VFSC liaison services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 - 7,000 per annum, applicable only when the VFSC licence condition or card scheme/acquirer rules mandate a certified independent audit; otherwise USD 0 because the general International Company audit exemption applies

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu abolished income tax and has not re-enacted corporate income tax. An International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act 1992 (Cap 222) is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu taxes, duties, and charges: no CIT, no payroll tax, no social security levy, no capital gains tax, no stamp duty on share transfers, and no withholding tax on distributions. VAT at 12.5% applies only to local consumption and is zero-rated for exported cross-border payment services. The only mandatory periodic exchequer cost is the VFSC annual license fee, which is tariff-based on authorized capital. Cross-border merchant acquiring fees earned by the IC from non-resident merchants are therefore effectively taxed at 0%. CRS/FATCA obligations may still require financial-account reporting through Vanuatu financial institutions.
